template.name: Nix Agent Workspace | Any Package, Any Version, Password-Gated
template.description: A coding agent with all of nixpkgs on Railway: light alpine+nix image, zix installs any package version in seconds, loopback-only agent behind basic auth.

required_inputs.description: Basic-auth password for the agent surface.

note: EXAMPLE shaped like the manifest railway.com generates at /deploy/<slug>/manifest.json after `railway templates create|publish`. The real values (template id, image digest, ready-seconds, validation) are produced by that publish flow - scripts/publish-template.sh walks it.
